hook.say: Green mountains, tea gardens and a famous philosopher. Five questions on Turkey's Black Sea coast!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which crop covers the hills of Rize on the Black Sea?
questions.say: Which crop covers the hills of Ree-zeh, on the Black Sea?
questions.fact: Most Turkish tea comes from Rize Province.
questions.sayAnswer: Tea! Most Turkish tea comes from Ree-zeh Province.

questions.q: Which small fish is the star of Black Sea cooking?
questions.say: Which small fish is the star of Black Sea cooking?
questions.fact: Trabzon is famous across Türkiye for its hamsi.
questions.sayAnswer: Hamsi, the anchovy! The city of Trabzon is famous across Turkey for it.

questions.q: Which monastery clings to a cliff near Trabzon?
questions.say: Which monastery clings to a cliff near Trabzon?
questions.fact: Sümela sits about 1,200 m up in the Pontic Mountains.
questions.sayAnswer: Soo-meh-la! It sits about 1200 meters up in the Pontic Mountains.

questions.q: Which bowed string instrument is typical of the Black Sea coast?
questions.say: Which bowed string instrument is typical of the Black Sea coast?
questions.fact: The Black Sea kemençe has three strings and is played upright.
questions.sayAnswer: The keh-men-cheh! It has 3 strings and is played upright.

questions.q: Which Black Sea city was the birthplace of the philosopher Diogenes?
questions.say: Which Black Sea city was the birthplace of the philosopher Diogenes?
questions.fact: Diogenes the Cynic was born in ancient Sinope around 412 BC.
questions.sayAnswer: Sinop! Diogenes the Cynic was born there, in ancient Sinope, around 412 B C.
